character: The Temple of Speed — 5.8km low-downforce circuit with long straights and heavy braking chicanes. Top speed and braking stability are everything. Exit speed from slow corners feeds massive straights.
sources: https://www.formula1.com/en/racing/2026/italy/circuit official F1 circuit guide; Lesmo/Ascari/Parabolica naming long-established

corners.name: Variante del Rettifilo
corners.technique: Brake between 150m and 100m board, trail brake to late apex in T1, smooth transition to T2. Hug flat inside kerb, avoid sausage kerbs
corners.trap: Braking too late and cutting the chicane; early T1 apex kills T2 exit speed

corners.name: Curva Grande
corners.technique: Flat-out in most cars, use full track width, smooth steering
corners.trap: Any correction at this speed scrubs massive time

corners.name: Variante della Roggia
corners.technique: Hard braking from high speed, aggressive downshifts, use astroturf reference for turn-in
corners.trap: Bouncing over sausage kerbs destabilises the car for Lesmo approach

corners.name: Lesmo 1
corners.technique: Keep left, brake later than you think. Use orange barrier as braking ref. Trail brake with 20% pressure into the turn
corners.trap: Excessive caution here — it's faster than it looks. Running wide kills Lesmo 2 entry

corners.name: Lesmo 2
corners.technique: Brake at 50m board, mid-to-late apex. Clean exit is critical — feeds long straight to Ascari
corners.trap: Too tight an apex loses exit speed; use all exit kerbing and astroturf

corners.name: Ascari
corners.technique: Brake late but maintain control through the sequence, smooth direction changes
corners.trap: Over-driving the entry compromises the final exit onto the straight to Parabolica

corners.name: Parabolica
corners.technique: Brake at 100m board, late apex, progressive throttle. Exit speed feeds the longest straight
corners.trap: Early apex = early throttle = massive oversteer on exit. Patience is everything here
